mapper.select: SELECT so.id AS order_id, so.order_no AS order_no, so.customer_id AS customer_id, so.customer_name_snapshot AS customer_name_snapshot, so.seller_id AS seller_id FROM sales_order so WHERE so.id = #{orderId} AND so.deleted = FALSE

SELECT r.id AS refund_id, r.refund_no AS refund_no, r.order_id AS order_id, r.customer_id AS customer_id, r.refund_amount AS refund_amount, r.status AS status FROM order_refund r WHERE r.id = #{refundId} AND r.deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE
SELECT p.id FROM finance_payment p WHERE p.source_type = 'ORDER_REFUND' AND p.source_id = #{orderRefundId} AND p.entry_type = 'NORMAL' AND p.deleted = FALSE LIMIT 1
